sections.heading: Tabs That Hold, Faces That Sell
sections.text: Peg Retail Packaging Tabs That Hold, Faces That Sell Hang tab boxes live a hard life: yanked off pegs, rehung, knocked by trolleys. The failure point is always the tab — so ours are reinforced with a double-board laminate zone around the die-cut, load-rated to the product weight you declare. Slot geometry follows the fixture: euro-slot for standard pegboard, round hook-hole for wire pegs, delta cuts for double-prong security pegs. The print face is engineered for the 1-metre read — product name and key claim legible from aisle distance. Windows show the product; hang-and-stand hybrid bases let the same SKU work pegs and shelves. Related: folding cartons and phone case retail boxes .

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions Will the tab tear with a heavier product? Tab zones are double-board laminated and load-rated to the weight you declare — tell us the grams and we engineer and test to it. Which slot type do I need? Euro-slot fits standard pegboard, round holes fit wire hooks, delta cuts fit double-prong security pegs. Send a photo of the fixture and we match it. Can the box also stand on a shelf? Yes — hang-and-stand hybrid bases let the same carton work pegs and flat shelves without repacking. Can you add a product window? Yes, PET-filmed or open die-cut windows engineered to survive repeated rehanging. What is the MOQ? 500 pcs; white structural samples in 48h.
